routesToMount.mountNote: Import as vendorRouter and call app.use('/', vendorRouter) in artifacts/api-server/src/app.ts (after adminAuthWithExceptions is applied). All paths self-prefix (/public/creative-vendors/*, /ai/creative-vendors/*).

pagesToRegister.note: Browse and search creative vendors with filters by type, province, availability.
Full vendor profile: portfolio (approved), capabilities, certifications, contact form. Contact request requires workspace token.
Admin vendor list with moderation (approve/reject) and analytics summary.
Admin vendor detail: portfolio moderation (per-item approve/reject) and contact request management.

sidebarItems.label: Creative Vendors
sidebarItems.note: Add to ai-platform sidebar nav after Creative Marketplace entry.

designDecisions.decision: Tables defined locally in domain schema.ts using local drizzle instance
designDecisions.reason: Avoids touching shared lib/db/src/schema/index.ts during parallel development. Team 24 promotes to shared on merge.

designDecisions.decision: Contact info always masked in public DTO (whatsapp: first 5 chars + *****, email: 3 chars + *** + @domain)
designDecisions.reason: Privacy protection — full contact only revealed to requester after vendor accepts contact request.

designDecisions.decision: Portfolio items require admin moderation (pending → approved/rejected) before public visibility
designDecisions.reason: Quality gate to prevent spam/inappropriate content in the public directory.

designDecisions.decision: Pricing fields are display-only (minPrice/maxPrice), not wired to any checkout or RAB system
designDecisions.reason: As specified: prices are optional and not used for procurement or payment payout.

designDecisions.decision: Compatibility scoring: category(30) + area(25) + availability(20) + rating(15) + verification(10) = 100
designDecisions.reason: Weighted scoring ensures category and proximity are most important, with rating and trust signals secondary.

designDecisions.decision: No procurement, payment payout, or automatic messaging implemented

knownRisks.risk: resolveWorkspaceSession API may change — vendorRouter uses same pattern as team-04/creative-marketplace
If lib/db/src/schema/index.ts is not updated by Team 24, other teams cannot import vendor tables from @workspace/db
knownRisks.mitigation: Domain is fully self-contained; only affects cross-team imports.

knownRisks.risk: avgRating recalculation happens after rating moderation; before approval, avgRating stays at 0
knownRisks.mitigation: Expected behavior — ratings only count when approved.

covers: recommendation scoring (category, area, availability, rating, verification)
portfolio moderation (approve clears note, reject stores reason, pending not in public view)
public data redaction (whatsapp masked, email masked, moderationNote absent)
contact terminal state guard (accepted/declined → throws on re-update)
contact reveal (full info only when status=accepted)
